d: Tech giants are pouring billions into artificial intelligence, but the promise of a more productive future is coming with an uncomfortable price: jobs. Innodata has reportedly laid off more than 500 employees in India, with cuts also affecting workers in the Philippines. Amazon continues to trim its workforce even as it ramps up AI investments, Microsoft has offered voluntary buyouts, and the Netherlands is considering civil service cuts in the name of AI-driven efficiency. As corporations and governments race to automate, the question is no longer just what AI can do, but what happens to…
